verdicts.title: Fibers of tropicalization
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We use functoriality of tropicalization and the geometry of projections of subvarieties of tori to show that the fibers of the tropicalization map are dense in the Zariski topology. For subvarieties of tori over fields of generalized power series, points in each tropical fiber are obtained "constructively" using Kedlaya's transfinite version of Newton's method.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses density of fibers of the tropicalization map and constructive point-finding via Newton's method, with no mention of Hodge classes, BDDs, or rank bounds. It shares only the 'tropicalization' vocabulary with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Implicitization of surfaces via geometric tropicalization
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we further develop the theory of geometric tropicalization due to Hacking, Keel and Tevelev and we describe tropical methods for implicitization of surfaces. verdicts.title: Positively Hyperbolic Varieties, Tropicalization, and Positroids
